summary: Completed comprehensive testing of newly implemented features: Desktop Hero Banner with Side Panels, Video Player Like/Heart Feature, Stories Page (TikTok-style), and Mobile Floating Button. All 20 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI features working correctly.

POST /api/episodes/like - Requires authentication (401 for anon)
POST /api/episodes/like - Successfully likes an episode (returns liked=true, updated count)

POST /api/episodes/unlike - Successfully unlikes an episode (returns liked=false, updated count)
POST /api/episodes/unlike - Returns 400 for not-liked episode
GET /api/episodes/{id}/like-status - Anonymous users get liked=false with likes count
GET /api/episodes/{id}/like-status - Authenticated users see their like status
